Hi Susan — thanks for the clear asks. Short answers up front:

• Term change: we can handle this as an amendment to the existing agreement (change order) — no full re-sign of the master is required.
• Capacity uplift: requires a brief SOW (1–2 pages) to capture the committed uplift and burst pool terms; pricing will be appended to that SOW.
• Onboarding evidence: SOC2 Type II 2025 report + network/IP allowlist details for portal access are sufficient to complete vendor re-certification.

I’ve attached a quick mutual action plan template and will draft a proposed SOW for the uplift. If you have target dates for PO submission and signature, include them in the MAP so we can hit the deadlines.

We can also offer a one-time 10% commitment discount on the uplift if the amendment is signed and PO issued before 2026-02-28. Let me know if procurement needs that stated in writing for approvals.

Thanks,
Olga
